data.long_meaning: Avinesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘ava’ meaning ‘desire’ and ‘ish’ meaning ‘Lord Vishnu’. This name signifies the deep longing and devotion towards Lord Vishnu. The name Avinesh carries the meaning “Desire for Lord Vishnu” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avinesh usually hope their child will grow to embody desire for lord vishnu and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name 'Avinesh' may have also derived from the ancient Indian epic 'Mahabharata'. Avinash is the name of a character in the epic, who is an advisor to the Pandava prince Bhima. In the story, Avinash is the embodiment of the Hindu god Yama, the god of death.
